title: Tiered Eviction & Auditable Evidence Pipeline for LLM Artifacts
creator: Ayesha Patel
description:
Background: Customers operating in regulated industries require deterministic retention behavior for prompts, model responses, request logs, and metrics. Current per-route TTLs exist but lack: (1) multi-tier eviction (hot/warm/cold), (2) signed evidence export for regulatory audits, and (3) residency-aware archival paths. This ticket defines a product-level policy object and an end-to-end pipeline to enforce retention, produce certified evidence files, and surface previews in the Console.

Scope: Define policy semantics, Console UX for policy creation/preview, API/schema for per-tenant and per-route overrides, backend enforcement hooks (archive/export), and an evidence bundling/service that generates cryptographic manifests and audit metadata. Excludes deep archival storage integrations (handled in follow-ups).

Reasoning: Many enterprise customers request fine-grained controls: keep prompts/response pairs for 30 days in hot storage for realtime debugging, retain aggregated metrics for 3 years for compliance, and produce signed evidence bundles on legal hold. We must provide operational tools that reduce support lift and scale across Dedicated/Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Define a JSON policy schema that supports per-tenant and per-route TTLs, tiered retention classes (hot/warm/cold), and residency constraints (region-ID).
Console: Add 'Lifecycle Policy Builder' flow with preview that simulates dataset size and monthly cost impact for chosen TTLs/tiering.
API: Expose endpoints to set/get/delete lifecycle policies and preview retention effect for a sample selector.
Backend: Implement eviction worker that marks artifacts for archive/delete according to tier and produces an evidence manifest for each eviction run.
Evidence: Generate compressed evidence bundles containing sample hashes, signed manifest, custody chain, and retention metadata; downloadable from Console with RBAC checks.
E2E tests: Automated tests covering policy precedence (tenant -> route -> default), cross-region residency enforcement, and evidence integrity verification.
Documentation: Confluence guide, Console help text, and SDK examples for common compliance templates (SOX/GDPR/CCPA).
proposed_solution:
Product: Introduce a 'Retention Policy' object with fields: selector (route/tenant/label), retention_tiers (ordered list with ttl_seconds, storage_class, region), hard_delete_after (optional), evidence_on_eviction boolean, and reason_template. Policies evaluate in precedence: route override -> tenant policy -> org default.

Console: New modal 'Lifecycle Policy Builder' where PMs/Compliance officers choose templates (e.g., 'Short Dev', 'Standard Enterprise', 'Regulated Long-term'), customize tiers and see an immediate preview of retention counts and estimated monthly storage/cost. Preview uses sampled telemetry from the last 30 days.

Backend: Eviction worker runs daily per-region. For items moving from hot->warm we update storage_class metadata and optionally copy to cheaper buckets; on eviction with evidence_on_eviction=true we stream the artifact, compute content-addressed hashes, include request/response metadata, append metrics time-window, and produce a signed manifest (HMAC with KMS key). Evidence bundles are uploaded to a region-bound evidence store and a signed download URL is emitted.

API/SDK: /policies endpoints, /policies/preview (POST sample selector returns estimated counts and cost), and /evidence/{bundle_id} for retrieval. RBAC: enterprise roles required to download evidence.

Observability: Add per-policy telemetry: items-evaluated, items-evicted, bundles-generated, errors. Wire these to Console's retention dashboard and alert on abnormal eviction rates.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (beta, Hosted only): Implement schema, API, and Console builder with preview; backend eviction marking without physical archival (mark-only mode) to test behavior. Target group: 5 enterprise customers and internal QA.

Phase 2 (GA): Enable archive/copy paths, evidence bundle generation, signed manifests, RBAC, and expose download workflow in Console. Enable on Dedicated/Private with config flags for KMS/HSM integration.

Phase 3: Provide pre-built compliance templates and legal-hold on-demand export. Integrate with retention-simulator for cost optimization suggestions.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Evidence bundles may contain sensitive PII - Mitigation: Integrate PII-scanning and redaction pipeline before bundle finalization and require tenant opt-in or legal hold scopes.
Risk: Cross-region residency enforcement complexity - Mitigation: Validate policy in preview against known region capabilities and fail policy save if impossible placement is requested.
Risk: Cost blowup from retaining large raw responses - Mitigation: Provide 'sampling' options and size-based tiering defaults; display cost preview in Console.
Risk: Key management for signed manifests - Mitigation: Integrate with customer KMS/HSM for Private deployments and with Redwood KMS for Hosted with audit logs.
